_about: Settings for the Cost tab, entered by hand. monthlyBudget is the Azure budget for the platform in AUD per calendar month; budgetByMonth overrides it for single months (for example {"2026-12": 17500}). forecast.runRateDays is how many recent days the month-end forecast averages. dailyThresholds flag a day when total platform cost, or one service's cost, goes above the amount given (AUD a day). All values are invented examples, not agreed budgets.
